column2: * The Svalinn Unique Shield's Cast on Block Skill now has Supported Skills Cost nothing. It also now has +50-100 Runic Ward, existing items are not affected by this change.
- Svalinn now has "You take 0-20% of Damage From Blocked Hits" (previously 15-20%). - Svalinn now has "200-300% Increased Armour" (previously 150 to 200%).

- Fixed a bug where the Cast on Block Skill granted by the Svalinn Unique Shield was granting the wrong amount of energy. It now grants 25 base energy on block (previously displayed 250 but actually granting 2.5).
